mass.title: The client served itself
mass.description: Clients serve themselves. Link onboarding to AI support to double support capacity. Compute can still be the bottleneck.
mass.tradeoff: Hosting +$32 per sprint. Cannot run alongside personal support.

premium.title: Now that is enterprise
premium.description: Large clients get a personal manager. CRM v2 linked to AI support lets large companies accept a price up to ×2 without a penalty. You set the price yourself.
premium.tradeoff: Hosting +$96 per sprint. With batch processing, the penalty-free price limit is only ×1.25.

batch.title: Your answer was ready yesterday
batch.description: Requests run in batches: the model processes a whole group at once. Cheaper, but answers take longer.
batch.tradeoff: Large-company satisfaction −12, named-client patience −1. Clients needing fast answers stop joining.

instant.title: While you were typing
instant.description: Every request is processed immediately. Clients recommend the product and wait longer for improvements.
instant.tradeoff: Tokens +20%, hosting +$48 per sprint. Cannot run alongside batch processing.

leads.title: Someone noticed us in a chat
leads.description: Four companies are already interested in the product. Their contacts join the lead list immediately.
leads.tradeoff: Potential clients need free seats and a working product.

consulting.title: One tiny consulting job
consulting.description: The one-time side job has been paid. Its money is available for product development now.
consulting.tradeoff: Once per startup. There will be no repeat contract.

credits.title: Provider credits
credits.description: The provider approved an infrastructure grant. Its money is available for product development now.
credits.tradeoff: Once per startup. This grant cannot be claimed again.

maintenance.title: Before anyone complains
maintenance.description: Apply ready fixes to reduce technical debt immediately.

rest.title: The founder stepped outside
rest.description: A short break restores the founder's energy immediately.
